sentences.cn_source: 过去这里很少发生故意破坏公物的事。

sentences.c: Complaints seemed to be an everyday occurrence.
sentences.cn_source: 投诉似乎成了天天发生的事。

sentences.c: One of them is a word counter, which counts for certain word occurrence in several files.
sentences.cn_source: 其中之一是单词计数器，它统计某一单词在几个文件中出现的次数。
